name: market-research
description: Six-phase methodology for evaluating commercial viability of digital products. Calibrated for solo founder context. Seven slash commands for phase invocation, seven subagents for adapted prompt execution. Persists multi-candidate state as JSONL files under the project's .claude/market-research/ directory. References Firecrawl, Exa, and Apollo marketplace plugins when installed; falls back to general-purpose tools when absent.
